subject.title: feat: add hosted feed envelope verifier

question: After the payload-byte DSSE fix, should this verifier land now as the hosted feed trust foundation or wait for the first consumer slice?
rationale: The patch defines the trust primitive future hosted-feed config, refresh, snapshot, CLI, and install-policy work would rely on, so the final landing order and security acceptance need maintainer intent.

options.title: Fix DSSE bytes, then land foundation
options.body: Correct the PAE input to decoded serialized bytes, refresh proof, and let the assigned reviewer re-approve this foundation slice.

options.title: Hold for refresh consumer
options.body: Pause this PR until the first signed-refresh consumer can prove the full trusted-feed behavior together.

options.title: Approve encoded-payload variant
options.body: Record an explicit RFC decision that OpenClaw intentionally signs the encoded envelope payload rather than DSSE serialized body bytes.

recommendation.title: Fix DSSE bytes, then land foundation
recommendation.body: Correct the PAE input to decoded serialized bytes, refresh proof, and let the assigned reviewer re-approve this foundation slice.
